- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The admission process for part-time MBA programs typically involves checking eligibility criteria, submitting an online application, providing GMAT or GRE scores, and possibly attending interviews.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Average GMAT scores for part-time MBA programs: Top-ranked programs: 650-700+, Well-regarded programs: 600-650, Regional programs: 550-600.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A strong overall application can compensate for a lower GMAT score, and some programs may offer GMAT waivers or alternative admission requirements.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Additional tips include researching programs, preparing well for the GMAT or GRE, highlighting work experience, and showing a clear career progression.
